title: Fake military UFO letter used to test Bill Moore

tellings.quote: basically he got a letter that was sent to AppPro and Appro looked at it and said, "Well, why don't you check this out?"

plain: Around 1979 or 1980, a letter made to look like it came from the military, about UFOs, was sent as a way of testing a man named Bill Moore, possibly with a New Mexico connection. The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels what Moore told him: the letter went first to APRO, a civilian UFO research group, and APRO passed it on to Moore, saying, "Well, why don't you check this out?" If true, it would mean someone was feeding planted papers into UFO circles to see what a researcher would do with them.
